newsitem.title: ITALY: Family of six shot to death in southern Italy.
newsitem.headline: Family of six shot to death in southern Italy.

text.p: Six people from the same family, including an 11-year-old girl, have been shot and killed in southern Italy, police said on Wednesday.
Police said the shooting occurred late on Tuesday at the home of an elderly couple in Diamante, a town in the southern Calabria region. The couple were among those killed.
Police said all the victims were relatives of a Carabinieri paramilitary police officer and investigators were now looking for him.

Police said some 20 shots had been fired inside the home but released no other details of the shooting. They did not say whether they believed the killings were the work of a single gunman or of several assailants.
